## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` and `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` are clean
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a bug fix has one that fails without the fix
- [ ] Public API changes are documented (dartdoc comments) and, if a feature page
      in [`doc/`](../doc) covers this area, updated there too
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry, if this is user-visible
